name: Cunard
desc: British luxury cruise line operating Queen Mary 2, Queen Victoria, Queen Elizabeth and Queen Anne on transatlantic and world voyages.
products: transatlantic crossings, world cruises, Mediterranean and Caribbean cruises
markets: Transatlantic, Mediterranean, Northern Europe, Caribbean, world cruises

signals.what: Carnival announced Queen Anne will leave Cunard for P&O Cruises in 2029

name: Davy
desc: Irish stockbroker, wealth manager and capital markets firm with offices in Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Galway and London, owned by Bank of Ireland.
products: wealth management, stockbroking, capital markets, asset management
customers: Irish private clients, institutions and corporates
parent_ultimate: Bank of Ireland Group plc (Euronext Dublin/LSE)

name: Free2Move
subsector: car sharing, rental and mobility apps
desc: Stellantis mobility brand offering car sharing, rental, subscription and mobility apps, enlarged by the Share Now acquisition.

name: Tennent Caledonian
desc: Glasgow brewer of Tennent's Lager, Scotland's best-known beer brand, owned by Dublin-listed C&C Group since 2009.
products: Tennent's Lager and variants; contract brewing (Innis & Gunn, Hawkstone)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Long history of own sports and festival sponsorships (Wikipedia)

signals.what: Brews Hawkstone lagers under licence at Glasgow brewery

fit_rationale: Tennent's is a heavy sports and festival sponsor in Scotland; F1 is a poor match for a domestic Scottish lager, and beer is a contested category.

name: Aprilia
desc: Italian sports motorcycle and scooter maker with a factory MotoGP team, Aprilia Racing, owned by Piaggio Group since 2004.
products: RSV4, Tuono, RS 660 motorcycles, scooters, Aprilia Racing MotoGP programme
customers: motorcycle enthusiasts in Europe and worldwide
parent_ultimate: Piaggio & C. SpA (Borsa Italiana; Colaninno family control not verified)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own HQ, racing operation and leadership (Wikipedia)

RSV4 X 250TH limited edition; leading 2026 MotoGP standings (provisional)

fit_rationale: Aprilia is a racing-led motorcycle brand already spending heavily on MotoGP; F1 hospitality and cross-promotion reach the same performance-motoring fans in Italy, Spain and beyond.
category_conflict: potential: Ducati (VW group) and other two-wheel brands; none in F1 found
f1_markets: Italy, Spain, Austria, UK, Japan, Qatar

access.roles: CEO; Aprilia Racing principal; Marketing Director
